answer: Possibly. After the census date a unit changes to WD-LATE, which is recorded as WDN rather than a fail grade, or to WD-FAIL, which is recorded as a WN fail grade. The pages do not say which code applies to a given case.

points.text: A unit withdrawn late with WD-LATE is recorded on your transcript as WDN, not as a fail grade, but you will be liable for your fees with no refund.
